# Nashville Luxury List

> Nashville Luxury List is the luxury real estate brand and weekly newsletter of Jason Kloess, a REALTOR® with Compass in Nashville, Tennessee (Tennessee license #357138). Jason represents buyers and sellers of $1.5M+ homes across Nashville and Williamson County, including East Nashville, 12 South, Belle Meade, Green Hills, Brentwood, Franklin and Thompson's Station.

Contact: 615-457-0768 · jason@nashvilleluxurylist.com · Compass Nashville, 1610 West End Ave, Suite 115, Nashville, TN 37203 (office 615-522-5100).

## Key pages

- [Nashville Luxury Real Estate FAQ (2026)](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/faq/): Direct answers and 2026 market data (median prices, days on market, sale-to-list) by neighborhood, plus who Jason Kloess is and how to reach him.
- [Relocating to Nashville (2026)](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/): For $1.5M+ buyers moving to Nashville, Brentwood, Franklin or College Grove: property tax by county (e.g. ~$21,105/yr on a $3M home in Davidson County USD vs ~$11,175 in Brentwood), Tennessee income-tax comparison, fall 2026 market data, an 11-area side-by-side comparison, the remote-buying process and a relocation FAQ. Offers the free 25-page Nashville Relocation Playbook (PDF).
- [Nashville Luxury Realtor](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/nashville-luxury-realtor/): How to choose a luxury agent in Nashville, Jason Kloess's closed sales and listing marketing, and 2026 prices by area (Belle Meade, Green Hills, East Nashville and more).
- [Brentwood, TN Luxury Realtor](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/brentwood-tn-luxury-realtor/): Brentwood 2026 market data, gated communities (Governors Club, Annandale, Rosebrooke), schools, property tax and what to ask a Brentwood luxury agent.
- [Franklin, TN Luxury Realtor](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/franklin-tn-luxury-realtor/): Franklin 2026 market data, luxury neighborhoods (historic downtown, Westhaven, Laurelbrooke, Leiper's Fork), FSSD vs. Williamson County Schools and property tax.
- [About Jason Kloess](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/about/): Background, approach and services for buyers and sellers.
- [Neighborhoods](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/): Overviews of Nashville's luxury neighborhoods.
- [Buyer's Guide](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/buyer-guide/): How buying a $1.5M+ home in Nashville works, with a downloadable PDF guide.
- [Seller's Guide](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/seller-guide/): How Jason markets and sells luxury homes, with a downloadable PDF guide.
- [Free Home Valuation](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/home-valuation/): Request a comparative market analysis.
- [Weekly Newsletter](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/newsletter/): Sign up for the weekly list of Nashville's top luxury homes and off-market opportunities.
- [Blog](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/blog/): Weekly luxury home roundups and market insights.
- [Contact](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/contact/): Reach Jason directly.

## Gated, golf and village communities

- [Governors Club, Brentwood](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/governors-club/): Guard-gated golf community with an Arnold Palmer course.
- [Annandale, Brentwood](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/annandale/): Gated estate community of about 180 homes built since 2006.
- [Westhaven, Franklin](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/westhaven/): Walkable master-planned community with a town center and private golf club.
- [Laurelbrooke, Franklin](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/laurelbrooke/): Guard-gated estates on nearly 600 acres.
- [Legends Ridge, Franklin](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/legends-ridge/): Gated acre-lot community next to Vanderbilt Legends Club.
- [The Grove, College Grove](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/the-grove/): Gated Greg Norman golf community; membership required.
- [Troubadour, College Grove](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/troubadour/): Discovery Land Company club community with a Tom Fazio course.
- [Leiper's Fork](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/leipers-fork/): Historic village with farms and estates on the Natchez Trace.

## City lifestyle guides

- [Living in Nashville](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/living-in-nashville/): A local's guide to Nashville restaurants (Audrey, Bastion, Rolf and Daughters, Arnold's), coffee, parks (Radnor Lake, Warner Parks, Cheekwood), farmers markets with days, neighborhoods, clubs, private schools and a sample Saturday. Free 6-page printable PDF.
- [Living in Brentwood, TN](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/living-in-brentwood/): Brentwood parks and greenways (Crockett Park, Smith Park and Ravenswood), restaurants and coffee, gated neighborhoods (Governors Club, Annandale, Taramore), clubs and schools. Free 6-page printable PDF.
- [Living in Franklin, TN](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/living-in-franklin/): Historic Main Street, the Franklin Theatre, Carnton, Harlinsdale Farm, the Saturday farmers market at The Factory, Leiper's Fork, restaurants and coffee, neighborhoods (Westhaven, The Grove, Troubadour) and FSSD vs. Williamson County Schools. Free 6-page printable PDF.
